question: What trust and ownership boundary should the Dashboard browser preview use before implementation?
rationale: The feature would expose sensitive browser state and may live as core Control UI, browser-plugin-owned UI, or a modular dashboard widget; automation cannot safely choose that product/security boundary.

options.title: Read-only-first admin panel
options.body: Add a secured panel for tabs, URL/title, screenshots, console/errors, and status while requiring explicit operator steps for clicks, credentials, navigation, and submits.

options.title: Browser-plugin-owned tab
options.body: Implement the surface through the plugin tab seam after maintainers approve the browser plugin UI contract and update model.

options.title: Defer to modular dashboard
options.body: Wait for the modular dashboard series and define browser preview as a sandboxed widget only if that model satisfies the live-browser requirements.

recommendation.title: Read-only-first admin panel
recommendation.body: Add a secured panel for tabs, URL/title, screenshots, console/errors, and status while requiring explicit operator steps for clicks, credentials, navigation, and submits.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal across browser runtime, Control UI routing, plugin-tab introduction, and prior issue discussion.
